name: @unbrowse/undici-shim
description: Drop-in replacement for undici. A safe GET routes through Unbrowse's resolved-route cache ($0 on hit); everything else is native fetch shaped into undici's ResponseData object — same request() returning { statusCode, headers, body } with body.text()/.json()/.arrayBuffer(), plus fetch and stub Client/Pool/Agent/setGlobalDispatcher/getGlobalDispatcher/interceptors.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm
